adimlar.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM orders;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS musteri_sayisi FROM customers;

SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS ciro
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi USING (order_id)
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT 
  date_part('year', order_purchase_timestamp)::integer AS yil,
  date_part('month', order_purchase_timestamp)::integer AS ay,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

SELECT p.product_category_name_english AS kategori, SUM(oi.price) AS ciro
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp))::numeric::decimal AS ortalama_teslim_suresi
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
AND order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL;

SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS musteri_sayisi
FROM customers c
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  op.payment_type, 
  SUM(op.payment_value) AS toplam_odenen
FROM 
  order_payments op
JOIN 
  orders o USING (order_id)
GROUP BY 
  op.payment_type;

SELECT AVG(review_score) AS ortalama_degerlendirme
FROM order_reviews;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) FROM sellers;

SELECT MAX(oi.price) AS en_pahalı_kalem_fiyatı
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS satici_sayisi
FROM sellers
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT review_score, COUNT(*) AS sayi
FROM order_reviews
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT payment_installments, COUNT(*) AS sıklık
FROM order_payments
WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.customer_city,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    c.customer_state, 
    ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS ortalama_siparis_tutari
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY 
    1
ORDER BY 
    3 DESC
LIMIT 3;

adimlar.sql:
SELECT sellers.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS ciro
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
JOIN sellers USING (seller_id)
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
  date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS ay, 
  SUM(oi.price) AS ciro
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi USING (order_id)
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(DOW FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS hafta_gunu,
  COUNT(*) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM orders
GROUP BY EXTRACT(DOW FROM order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY siparis_sayisi DESC;

SELECT 
    c.customer_state, 
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp) / 86400) AS teslimat_suresi_gun
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE 
    o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    1
ORDER BY 
    2 DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COUNT(order_id) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) >= 2 THEN customer_unique_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS oran
FROM customers
JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id
WHERE orders.order_status = 'delivered';
